notes: All 39 entries are candidate rerun requirements; no product test was executed in this session.
Remote SHA and source tree were read and verified; deployed runtime values require independent observation.
Historical receipts and prototype U1-U7 are references and cannot serve as current candidate pass evidence.
Suite paths are relative to repository root at source_reference_sha; suite candidates can include supporting source or historical evidence files.
Exact historical names are source references, not proof that each permanent assertion already has complete automated coverage.
Project uploads save opaque original bytes without content deep inspection; untrusted files remain contained at task execution.
Material form one-click, assistant explicit confirmation card, fixed eight-tier authoring and QA metered confirmation are distinct entry/billing rules.
QA/legacy metered unknown usage stays pending; new fixed 4500 document delivery settles independently of model usage availability.
Inventory completeness and unmapped-fix count remain unknown until all merged fixes and bug issues are reconciled.
No entry may be removed because a regression fails; keep prior failure evidence and versioned approved expectations.

Source uploads in the material form adopt the newly saved original; generic assistant attachments do not implicitly replace source. Non-QA business execution is distinct from legitimate help/chat QA runs.

v5 coverage review preserves all 76 original IDs and 39 fix entries, adds BB-077 account operations, BB-078 project lifecycle and BB-079 pause/resume. Shared executions reduce duplicate calls and reviews without weakening per-case assertions. Legacy upload parsing is retained; unified_v1 opaque upload has zero parse jobs.

v6 adds a scoped U invited-user-testing admission gate. Known scope/diff high-risk fix assertions remain mandatory; full historical inventory and all release regression requirements continue in parallel and are not claimed complete.
